B.name: Ater
B.line: Chief Israelite (or representative of the family) who sealed Nehemiah's covenant

first_reader_said: NEH 10:17: 'Ater, Hizkijah' echoes 'Ater of Hezekiah' (Ezra 2:16), so the sealer is the house of Ater, which A records; B is the same house held again.

why: Ezra 2:16 and Nehemiah 7:21 identify descendants of Ater of Hezekiah, without identifying Ater himself as a covenant sealer. Nehemiah 10:17 lists Ater and Hizkijah separately; its Hebrew does not say “Ater of Hezekiah.” The sealer could represent that ancestral family or be another namesake, so the text establishes neither personal identity nor distinctness.
